links.outcome: Diagnostic performance versus endodontist reference standard on retrospective CBCT scans, pre- vs postoperative
links.effect: Preoperative non-root-filled molars: sensitivity 93.9% (teeth), specificity 65.2%, PPV 71.8%; postoperative scans showed lower PPV (teeth 54.2%; roots 46.9%) and F1 (teeth 67.2%; roots 59.2%).
links.quote: Postoperative scans showed significantly lower PPV (teeth: 54.2 %; roots: 46.9 %) and F1 scores (teeth: 67.2 %; roots: 59.2 %).

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy of a commercial AI dental imaging software (Diagnocat) on retrospective CBCT scans compared to expert endodontists, without evaluating a specific implementation guardrail or deployment practice.
